lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with businesses in Charleston, West Virginia, on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Charleston is the state capital and the service centre for the Kanawha Valley. It is a small city with an outsized role: people drive in from many counties for hospitals, courts, state offices and shopping. We help local firms reach that wider valley audience and stay visible to the people who already know them.

sections.heading: The capital of the Kanawha Valley
paragraphs: The city sits where the Elk River meets the Kanawha, with the gold-domed Capitol on the East End and a compact downtown along Capitol Street. State government is a major employer, and so is the hospital system, which treats patients from across the southern half of the state. Law firms, lobbyists, accountants and associations gather here because the legislature and the courts do.

The valley has a long industrial history as well. Chemical plants line the river at South Charleston, Institute and Nitro, and engineering, maintenance and safety contractors have grown up around them. Three interstates meet in the city, which makes it a natural base for distribution and for trades that cover a broad territory.

sections.heading: Where customers live and how they travel
paragraphs: Charleston's neighbourhoods are shaped by the hills. South Hills is residential and well established, Kanawha City runs along the river with the hospital and a commercial strip, the East End and the West Side each have their own main streets, and the Elk City district has drawn new restaurants and shops. Beyond the city limits the market continues through South Charleston, Dunbar, St. Albans, Cross Lanes and into Putnam County at Teays Valley and Hurricane, where many families have moved.

People here think in terms of exits and river bridges, and they will drive a fair distance for a provider they trust. Huntington, about an hour west, is close enough that some firms serve both cities.
bullets: Pages for the valley towns you serve, named the way locals say them.
A service area on your business profile that reflects how far you really travel.
Ad targeting by county and corridor, not a circle that ignores the terrain.
Click-to-call on every page, because many customers prefer to phone.

sections.heading: The other Charleston problem
paragraphs: Any business in the city shares its name with a much larger tourist destination in South Carolina. Search engines usually sort this out by the searcher's location, but mistakes are common in ads, directory listings and AI answers. We guard against it by writing the state into titles and headings, using Kanawha County and neighbourhood names in the text, marking up the address in structured data, keeping directory listings consistent, and excluding South Carolina from ad campaigns. It is a small detail that saves a steady leak of wasted clicks and misdirected calls.

sections.heading: The local calendar
paragraphs: The legislative session in winter fills hotels, restaurants and meeting rooms downtown and brings a burst of work for firms that serve government. Early summer has FestivALL, and the Sternwheel Regatta draws crowds to the riverfront around Independence Day. The Capitol Market is busiest in the growing season and again before the holidays. Cold snaps and summer heat drive furnace and air-conditioning calls. We put these dates into your content plan and budget so the spending follows the demand.

faqs.q: Does TDM have an office in Charleston, WV?
faqs.a: No. We work with Charleston businesses remotely, with calls by phone or video and regular written reports.

faqs.q: How do I stop my business showing up for Charleston, South Carolina?
faqs.a: State West Virginia clearly in page titles, headings and your business profile, use local names such as Kanawha County and your neighbourhood, add address markup to the site, correct inconsistent directory listings and restrict ad locations to your service area. We check all of these at the start.

faqs.q: Can you help me reach customers in Putnam County and Huntington?
faqs.a: Yes. We build a page for each area, set your service area accordingly and run ads by county so you can see which places bring enquiries.

faqs.q: How much does digital marketing cost in Charleston?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope. We talk through your goals in a free consultation and then give you a quote.
